%!TEX program = xelatex
\documentclass{md2tex}

% 参考文献设置（仅正文存在 citation 时保留）
$if(bibliography)$
\usepackage{gbt7714}
\citestyle{numbers}
\renewcommand{\bibname}{参考文献}
$endif$

% 论文封面信息
$if(title)$
\newcommand{\papertitle}{$title$}
$else$
\newcommand{\papertitle}{文档标题}
$endif$
\newcommand{\securitylevel}{$security$}
% 保密年限：与密级分列两个变量，非空时以五角星（pifont 的 \ding{72}）连接
\newcommand{\securityyears}{$securityyears$}
\newcommand{\securitymark}{%
  \securitylevel\ifdefempty{\securityyears}{}{\ding{72}\securityyears}}
\newcommand{\doctype}{$doctype$}
\newcommand{\docnumber}{$docnumber$}
\newcommand{\docversion}{$docversion$}
\newcommand{\institution}{$institution$}
\newcommand{\dateofsubmit}{$submitdate$}

\begin{document}

% 封面
\begin{titlepage}
  \thispagestyle{empty}
  % 双线页框（外粗内细）
  \begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture, overlay]
    \draw[line width=1.5pt]
      ([shift={(11mm,-11mm)}]current page.north west)
      rectangle ([shift={(-11mm,11mm)}]current page.south east);
    \draw[line width=0.4pt]
      ([shift={(13.5mm,-13.5mm)}]current page.north west)
      rectangle ([shift={(-13.5mm,13.5mm)}]current page.south east);
  \end{tikzpicture}

  % 顶部信息栏：密级 / 编号居首行，版本次之，通栏细线收束
  {\noindent\heiti\enhei\zihao{-4}%
    密级：\securitymark\hfill \ifdefempty{\docnumber}{}{编号：\docnumber}\par}
  \vspace{4pt}
  {\noindent\heiti\enhei\zihao{-4}版本：\docversion\par}
  \vspace{4pt}
  {\noindent\rule{\textwidth}{0.8pt}\par}

  % 文件类型：居中、加宽字距，作题前引子
  \vspace{28mm}
  \begin{center}
    {\heiti\enhei\ziju{1.2}\zihao{2}\doctype\par}
  \end{center}

  % 题名
  \vspace{14mm}
  \begin{center}
    {\bs\zihao{1}\papertitle\par}
  \end{center}

  % 题名下装饰线（上粗下细双线）
  \vspace{16mm}
  \begin{center}
    {\rule{0.42\textwidth}{1.2pt}\par}
    \vspace{3pt}
    {\rule{0.42\textwidth}{0.4pt}\par}
  \end{center}

  \vfill

  % 落款：单位三号黑体、日期四号宋体
  \begin{center}
    {\heiti\enhei\zihao{3}\institution\par}
    \vspace{8mm}
    {\song\zihao{4}\dateofsubmit\par}
  \end{center}
  \vspace{22mm}
\end{titlepage}
\clearemptydoublepage

% 目录
\frontmatter
\setcounter{tocdepth}{1}
\ctexset{contentsname={\makebox[\textwidth][c]{\heiti\enhei\zihao{-2}目录}}}
\tableofcontents
\cleardoublepage
\mainmatter

\vspace{28pt}

% 正文
$body$

% 参考文献
$if(bibliography)$
\bibliography{references}
$endif$

\end{document}
